task: Add discount codes to orders. Create shop/discounts.py with a DISCOUNTS mapping of code to percent off: SAVE10 is 10 and HALF is 50. Give Order an optional discount_code field. In shop/pricing.py, apply the discount to the subtotal before tax, rounding each step to whole cents with half-up rounding. Codes are not case sensitive. An unknown code raises ValueError when the total is computed. Orders without a code must total exactly as they do today.
